title: The Spilled Glue
scene: At 11:35 AM, the craft fair glue gun was sabotaged. Booths were closed during rain from 11:20 to 12:00.

suspects.name: Ada Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at my booth at 11:35, gluing a sign.
suspects.contradiction: The booths were closed at 11:20, and glue was on Ada's apron.

suspects.name: Bruno Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the tent at 11:35, checking the schedule.
suspects.alibiProof: The tent camera shows Bruno at 11:33.

suspects.name: Celia Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the cafe at 11:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The cafe receipt for Celia is stamped 11:34.

suspects.name: Dario Lund
suspects.testimony: I was under the awning at 11:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The awning camera shows Dario at 11:30 and 11:41.
